task: Independent acceptance review of bounded guest String.lastIndexOf(String)

findings.title: Acceptance is deliberately bounded
findings.detail: This evidence supports only lastIndexOf(String). It does not support lastIndexOf(String,int), substring, general String/Java compatibility, or Minecraft completion. The package states those limits accurately; original30 is reported as running followed by atomic refusal, not as a pass.

review.parentDelta: The verifier pins six parent inputs, reconstructs the candidate engine as exactly nine domain substitutions plus one String image replacement, and requires exact coordinator/driver substitutions. The packaged diffs are consistent with that narrow delta.
review.java8Provenance: The pinned recipe is javac -source 8 -target 8 -g:none. The verifier recompiles with the pinned Java 8 javac and requires byte-for-byte equality, 1187 bytes, SHA-256 2fbfe5d57906f5ebd4f2eeaceb209edf8d4a619afb21d1531f7aaea121506033, and classfile major 52. Independent package-only extraction confirmed the size, hash, and major version.
review.bootstrapPreservation: Source verification requires 85 bootstrap functions with identical names and exact bytes for every image except _bootstrapString, requires String commitment slot 26, and retains the outlined tail/StringBuilder placement assertions. Fixed raw/checkpoint/frame/VFS/native/exception commitments are asserted unchanged.
review.guestSemantics: The added method is public ordinary Code, not native. It dereferences target.length() first, handles empty target as receiver length, rejects longer targets, scans candidate starts backward, compares UTF-16 char units, supports overlaps, and returns -1 when absent. Loop bounds avoid out-of-range charAt and integer overflow under valid String lengths. Null target therefore uses the existing guest invokevirtual NPE path.
review.gates: Every focused semantic witness runs q1/q7/direct plus reopen with terminal-success and machine-root/opaque-payload/step equivalence. Cases cover suffix, middle, prefix, overlap, repeats, absence, empty target/receiver, longer target, BMP UTF-16, surrogate pairs, and catchable null NPE. Retained initialization, replacement, raw-count/raw-byte, EnumSet, queue, and OOM controls are present, followed by independent canonical receipt re-encoding. The authoritative machine result reports source verification pass and 2565 canonical receipts.
review.claimHonesty: The gate says generated-only and explicitly excludes overloads, substring, regex, encoding, PrintStream output, original artifacts, and host String execution authority. machine-result.json sets substringClaimed and doneClaimed to false and labels original30's atomic refusal precisely.

independentChecks: Parsed all package JSON and all five Python tools; Node syntax-check passed for verify_receipts.js.
Extracted the candidate String class directly from engine.diff: 1187 bytes, SHA-256 2fbfe5d57906f5ebd4f2eeaceb209edf8d4a619afb21d1531f7aaea121506033, classfile major 52.
Parsed parent and candidate class method tables from the diff: the candidate preserves the parent fields/method surface and adds one public non-native lastIndexOf(Ljava/lang/String;)I Code method.
Compared a source-equivalent implementation against an independent UTF-16-unit oracle for 116025 exhaustive receiver/target combinations, including isolated surrogate units; all matched.
verificationLimits: No heavy build, EVM replay, original artifact access, network access, or other-worktree access was performed, as requested.
The machine result was treated as authoritative; runtime/gate execution claims were reviewed from the packaged scripts and machine-result.json rather than rerun.
